this-install:
# This install

This is the map of THIS install. It is rebuilt from live state at every startup (and agent, graph and collection pages update on change), and it is read-only: grep it, read it, do not write to it. It lists only what is public; your own and shared entities are in the console and the CRUD tools.

- [agents](this-install/agents) - every public agent, its purpose and its model
- [graphs](this-install/graphs) - every public graph and what it orchestrates
- [collections](this-install/collections) - every public collection on this install
- [workspaces](this-install/workspaces) - every public workspace and its phase
- [providers](this-install/providers) - LLM, embedding and search backends
